description: Summarize a URL or pasted text into 3-5 concise bullets. Fetches up to 500KB on the URL path, strips HTML with BeautifulSoup. Use for research distillation, link-rot insurance, agent reading lists. Exactly one of `text` or `url`. $0.01 USDC.

text.description: Pasted text to summarize. Omit if providing `url`.

url.description: URL to fetch + summarize. Omit if providing `text`.
